questions.question: OP-01/O70 (D109's list): D109 says O9's list is every AX-10 decision plus every decision whose Amends names D27 to D34. D109 is itself headed AX-10 but is not on the list. How is it fixed?

options.label: Exclude by rule (Recommended)
options.description: D109's rule reads: every AX-10 decision except one that only edits this list (D109). O9's list stays as it is, because D109 shapes no category. Source: D104, D109.

options.label: Add D109 to O9
options.description: O9's list in D104 and D108 gains D109. The rule holds literally, but the landing flow then reads a decision that only removed D85 from a list.

questions.question: OP-01/O70 (D111): D111 says 'D38's caller-level table, as D60 and D98 amend it', but D61 amends it too: it adds the unavailable row's 'on a stream, a new call reads the content current at its own open'. How does D111 read?

options.label: Add D61 (Recommended)
options.description: D111 reads 'as D60, D61 and D98 amend it'. This changes no decision about what O11 blocks. Source: D61's Amends, which names D38.

options.label: As is
options.description: D111 keeps its two-decision list. A reader of D111 then misses D61's stream row.

questions.question: OP-01/O70 (E4): D34's check says 'Every row of the Environment ... has a category', and D88's says every row has a row in D34's table. E4 has had none since D48 took it out of the changed row. Which fix?

options.label: E4 row in D34 (Recommended)
options.description: D34's table gains 'E4 | none of its own: never changed, a read may end short without failing (D26, D48, D99) | —'. Both checks hold as written, and a check can catch a changed raised under E4 (AX-10's counterexample). Source: D48, D99.

options.label: Reword both checks
options.description: D34's and D88's checks read 'every Environment row but E4, which surfaces no category of its own (D48)'. The table stays as it is, and E4's absence there is stated rather than shown.

questions.question: OP-01/O70 (D41): D41's check says each non-promise row names the decision whose limit it marks. NP8's scope, 'whole bytes and text', and NP9's (D71) name none. Which fix?

options.label: Name them (Recommended)
options.description: NP8's scope reads 'whole bytes and text (D1; D40 bounds the stream only)'. NP9's reads 'readline with a negative limit and line iteration, both forms (D40, D71)'. D41's check holds as written. Source: D1, D40, D71.

options.label: Narrow the check
options.description: D41's check reads 'each names its scope, and the decision whose limit it marks where one exists'. NP8 and NP9 stay as they are.
